#!/bin/bash

# File Cleanup Script
# Removes files older than 90 days from specified directory and logs actions

# Configuration
ARCHIVE_DIR="/workspace/archive"
LOG_FILE="/workspace/cleanup.log"
DAYS_OLD=90

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    local message="$1"
    local timestamp=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    echo "[$timestamp] $message" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Function to display error and exit
error_exit() {
    local message="$1"
    echo "ERROR: $message" >&2
    log_message "ERROR: $message"
    exit 1
}

# Main cleanup function
main() {
    # Verify archive directory exists
    if [[ ! -d "$ARCHIVE_DIR" ]]; then
        error_exit "Archive directory does not exist: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
    fi

    # Initialize log file if it doesn't exist
    if [[ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
        touch "$LOG_FILE" || error_exit "Cannot create log file: $LOG_FILE"
    fi

    # Log script start
    log_message "========== Cleanup Script Started =========="
    log_message "Archive directory: $ARCHIVE_DIR"
    log_message "Removing files older than $DAYS_OLD days"

    # Counter for deleted files
    deleted_count=0
    error_count=0

    # Find and remove files older than 90 days
    while IFS= read -r file; do
        if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
            if rm "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
                log_message "Deleted: $file"
                ((deleted_count++))
            else
                log_message "ERROR: Failed to delete: $file"
                ((error_count++))
            fi
        fi
    done < <(find "$ARCHIVE_DIR" -type f -mtime +$DAYS_OLD 2>/dev/null)
